{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Quandary''''' was a [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] which operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The run-down ship was piloted by an old crew who weren't in good condition also. [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin]] traveled aboard this ship when she was a fugitive from [[Ksiczzic III]] to [[Silver Station]].<ref name="SWAJ6">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref>
